coordinate_space: all anchor/contentBounds/occlusionHeight values are fractions 0-1 of the sprite canvas; multiply by the variant width/height

layer_encoding.shadow: opaque grayscale luminance mask; map luminance to alpha, tint black at 55% opacity
layer_encoding.glow: opaque RGB luminance carrier; map luminance to alpha, then screen/additive composition

animation_layers.note: derived from stage1 albedo (no generation): compose body → ring_back → sphere → ring_front; the sphere floats (sin, 6-8 s period, ±2% of height) with its glow; ring layers tilt/pulse slowly — do NOT rotate them (the ring interior is baked); orbit motes are runtime particles

derived_seed.method: bloom albedo: emissives x0.15 via glow mask, 45% desaturation, particles removed; same alpha and geometry
